title: Ward-level population estimates by single year of age and sex
description: Mid-year population estimates for electoral wards in England and Wales, broken down by single year of age and sex. Combines the mid-2020 experimental statistics release (2020 ward boundaries) with the mid-2021/mid-2022 release, which republishes both years against both the 2022 and 2023 ward boundaries.

files.note: Table SAPE23DT8a, mid-2020 on 2020 ward and 2021 LA boundaries. Sheet-per-sex layout, not yet read by a loader.
